-- class: expand
-- name: roles

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-role
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" with nosuperuser nocreatedb nocreaterole inherit nologin;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" revoke execute on functions from public;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" grant execute on functions to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" grant select on sequences to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" grant usage on sequences to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" grant delete on tables to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" grant insert on tables to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" grant select on tables to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter default privileges for role "mig_be7e25d31cfd" in schema "public" grant update on tables to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" text not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant delete on table "public"."tasks" to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant insert on table "public"."tasks" to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."tasks" to "app_11d14d43d46e";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant

-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant update on table "public"."tasks" to "app_11d14d43d46e";
